title: Hotdata
description: Creates one ephemeral Hotdata database for each pipeline run.
Lets agents inspect its live schema and execute read-only SQL before the database is destroyed at teardown.

llm.description: LLM used to generate SQL from natural language

hotdata.api_url.title: API URL
hotdata.api_url.description: Hotdata API base URL. Leave empty for https://api.hotdata.dev.

hotdata.ttl.title: Database lifetime
hotdata.ttl.description: Crash-safety expiry for the ephemeral database.

hotdata.table.title: Table
hotdata.table.description: Table that rows arriving on the answers lane are loaded into. Created on first use.

hotdata.db_description.title: Database description
hotdata.db_description.description: Schema and domain hints for natural-language SQL generation.

hotdata.max_execute_rows.title: Maximum execute rows
hotdata.max_execute_rows.description: Maximum rows returned by raw SQL execution.

hotdata.allow_destructive_load.title: Allow destructive loads
hotdata.allow_destructive_load.description: Permit load_data to use replace, update or delete modes, which overwrite or remove existing rows. Off by default: load_data is append/upsert only, so an agent cannot destroy data another pipeline step loaded.

hotdata.allow_execute.title: Allow direct query execution
hotdata.allow_execute.description: Permit trusted callers to submit raw read-only SQL.

hotdata.job_timeout_secs.title: Job timeout (seconds)
hotdata.job_timeout_secs.description: Maximum time to wait for an asynchronous query.

hotdata.async_after_ms.title: Run asynchronously after (milliseconds)
hotdata.async_after_ms.description: Wait this long before a query continues as an asynchronous job.
